x: Star of the day was Marlon Dickson who ran 26.9 for the colts' 200 metres. Marlon was presented with his award for man of the match by our own Marcus Adam with Lennie Paul doing the commentary over the PA.

• Marlon Dickson became a Surrey Champion early in the year when he won the indoor 60m in 7.8 at Crystal Palace on Feb 21st. • The Mini-Marathon trials to determine who would represent their boroughs in the young athletes races on London Marathon day gave two Belgravians a chance to show their paces.
In the U15 100m Marlon Dickson and Hugo Cavalier gave us a double victory and in the U13 event Stuart Erskine and Warren Stewart did the same thing.
Sprint hurdlers Mellisa Simon and Steve Scott were both held back by the gusting wind but Marlon Dickson and Daniel Jackman were able to use it to their advantage.
Many were the laughs (although not in front of the television cameras!) as our Marlon Dickson asked Colin Jackson if he had ever run in the English Schools - "Of course not.
Marlon Dickson just lost out by 1/10th in the under-15 200 metres and behind came James Hilston who had earlier run over a second faster into a 2.0 mps headwind in the heats.
Marlon Dickson was delighted with his 100 metres pb of 11.8 to equal Ludwig Nunoo's Club Record and he also scored heavily in the 200m and long jump.
James was not our only finalist, however, as Marlon Dickson picked up a 'silver' in the 100m and made that Club Record his own property alone in slicing off another 1/10th.
